presentation.title: Start with an asset you already own
presentation.body: Glina imports an existing GLB through the same structural and optional Blender gate used by generated work. The accepted copy becomes the active workspace asset; no generation or model call is made.

presentation.title: A result counts only after the gate passes
presentation.body: `glina verify` parses the GLB, measures its meshes, triangles, materials, and animations, and checks those facts against the active limits. It exits unsuccessfully when the artifact is broken or outside the contract instead of turning a failed gate into a warning.

presentation.title: Import the GLB you want to keep working on
presentation.body: Run the import on a real GLB. Glina validates the staged bytes before committing them, preserves existing assets, reports repeated content as unchanged and name collisions as conflicting, then makes an accepted destination the default for verify, animate, and preview-anim.
presentation.result: A JSON result with imported or unchanged status, the durable destination path, and the quality report that accepted it
